name: z-dev-flow
description: Takazudo Chat planning and standalone Codex or Claude Code handoffs for local or cloud development, with connected-computer observation

interface.longDescription: Plan in Chat, optionally prototype UI or sweep issues, and hand off a standalone prompt and available artifacts to Codex or Claude Code, locally or in the cloud. The implementation agent establishes issue tracking and records development progress. Seven skills: zdev, zplan, zproto, zgh, zstatus, zwatch and zkicadactions. Connected-computer observation remains available.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use zdev to help me plan and implement a development task.
